exposure: COVID-19 confirmed or suspected SARS-CoV-2 infection
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section after March 7th, 2020, with a comparison group of women who underwent cesarean section for similar indications during the same period but were not infected with SARS-CoV-2
finding: While PPE use did not significantly affect operative time, transfer to operating room time, or skin incision to delivery time, the COVID-19 pandemic and PPE use were associated with a significant increase in operating room time.
mod_finding: The COVID-19 pandemic and use of PPE was associated with increased operating room time for cesarean sections, but there was no significant difference in operative time, transfer time, or skin incision to delivery time.
